messages.subject: MTPC on 3 groups
parts:
Hi Chris,
I want to test for a difference between 3 groups  using MTPC+ANOVA with no covariates. Is that possible in brainGraph? 
I have used "X <- brainGraph_GLM_design(table_covars, coding='effects')"  to generate a design matrix. 
Could you please show me the command lines for mtpcContrast or the best way to do MTPC-based comparions between 3 groups? 

Thanks in advance,
Li

messages.author: dadcb4fd6a01f8d1
messages.subject: Re: [brainGraph-help] MTPC on 3 groups
parts:
For MTPC, a comparison with 3 groups is no different from 2 or 4 or any number (given that you have enough subjects). Please read through the User Guide to see how to use the "mtpc" function. You can also read the FSL GLM wiki page if you need help with design matrices and contrasts.

If you still need help, I will need more specific information to be able to help.
Chris
